PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Actuator type comon attributes.

PropertyDef.Name: FailPosition
PropertyDef.Definition: Identifies the types of fail position from which that required may be set.

PropertyDef.Name: ManualOverride
PropertyDef.Definition: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE). Note that this value should be set to FALSE by default in the case of a Hand Operated Actuator.
